gitCommit.subject: Fix CI failures: landing layout flash rendering + e2e infinite-scroll seed/selector
gitCommit.body:
Fix CI failures: landing layout flash rendering + e2e infinite-scroll seed/selector

The new self-contained landing layout dropped flash rendering, breaking the
unconfirmed-email redirect spec since LandingDomainConstraint treats
session-less test requests as landing-bound. Added a minimal flash block
using landing.css tokens (no Tailwind/Stimulus dependency).

The Playwright seed only created 3 transactions, so the hardened
infinite-scroll assertion (added in #285) could never see a second page.
Seeded enough filler transactions to exceed the 20/page threshold, and
scoped the ".scroll-trigger" selector to the visible element since the
hidden desktop trigger was also matching ".first()".

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
